remarks: Private oasis on 2.08ac. Mini Estate with matured trees, 3,887sq.ft 11 Rm, 4Br. 3Full Ba. & 2 Half Ba. of living space & 3 car. gar. Minutes to major highways, shops, entertainment and Golf Course. Inground gunite heated pool and guest house 1Br. Kit. 1Ba. Wide stone wall entry leads to the circular driveway and three car garage with parking for over ten cars. Sprinkler system and invisable fence. Hardwood floor through out. Cathedrial ceiling Autrum invites to spacious living rm. with fireplace and direct access to the back yard. Hallway leads to sun filled Play Rm. wrapped with windows, Dining Rm. with mirrored side walls, den with fireplace and to the generous size Chefs kitchen approx. 430sq.ft with marbled floor, pantry, Corian island, two separate sinks, sub zero frig & double wall ovens. Off the kitchen direct entry to up stairs-possible Au pair quarters, entry to front of the house, huge slate covered patio with sky lights, garage & half bath. Possible land subdivision buyer must do their own research in that regard. Vaulted ceiling Master Bedroom Suite, Granite Master Bath with make-up area, bidet and jacuzzi. Two other Bd. Rm on their own wing of the house sharing full bath. Pathway behind the pool leads to Coachmens Ct. cul-de-sac. City side walk and bike lane at the end of the driveway leads to Conn. Ave. Solar pannel contract. 400amp service, genarator ready. If you seek privacy this is it. As is condition. Located between Darien and New Cannan.
